name: Blood Feeders
summary: In Malaka'jin, the scent of butchered game draws Deepmoss spiders into the trolls' camps. Xen'Zilla asks the Horde to drive the predators back from the settlement.

sections.title: Unwanted Dinner Guests
sections.body: The trolls founded Malaka'jin as a frontier outpost in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains, where they could hunt. The craggy slopes yield plenty of game, but its meat draws nocturnal predators into camp. Deepmoss spiders are aggressive arachnids native to the crags and canyons to the north. Under cover of darkness, they slip in to scavenge the trolls' stores or hunt the hunters themselves.

sections.title: Clearing the Crags
sections.body: Xen'Zilla asks you to track the predators north into the mountain passes, keeping Malaka'jin safe and protecting its supplies. Deepmoss Creepers and Venomspitters gather thickest around the rocky ravines and webs of Sishir Canyon. Thinning their numbers pushes the brood back from the settlement, so the hunters can rest without fearing an ambush from the shadows.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Blood Feeders?
faq.answer: Xen'Zilla, a Darkspear troll in Malaka'jin in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains, offers the hunting contract to traveling Horde champions.

faq.q: Why are the spiders attacking Malaka'jin?
faq.answer: The scent of fresh kills and drying meat draws Deepmoss spiders down from the mountain passes at night. The trolls of Malaka'jin hunt the local game, and the spiders come to steal provisions and hunt the villagers.

faq.q: Where are the Deepmoss spiders located?
faq.answer: Deepmoss Creepers and Venomspitters roam the central passes and crags north of Malaka'jin. They gather especially thickly in the web-strewn ravine of Sishir Canyon.
Malaka'jin is a Darkspear troll encampment at the southern entrance to Stonetalon Mountains, near the Barrens border. It is a hunting base and Horde outpost on the frontier.

faq.q: Is there a greater threat tied to these spiders?
faq.answer: A massive, lethal spider matriarch lives deep in Sishir Canyon among the webs. A warning sign outside the canyon alerts travelers to the danger and urges groups to bring her down.

faq.q: What happens after the spiders are culled?
faq.answer: Culling the Creepers and Venomspitters gives Malaka'jin breathing room. Troll hunters can secure their meat stores and walk their camps at night without constant ambush.

angles.text: As a troll, you share kinship with the hunters of Malaka'jin, who strive to carve out self-sufficient territory in Kalimdor's rugged highlands without succumbing to the wilderness.
As a member of the Horde, you help safeguard Malaka'jin, which anchors the Horde's access route into Stonetalon Mountains from the northern Barrens. The village protects the entire southern pass.
As a hunter, tracking dangerous predators that out-hunt and harass friendly settlements is natural work for a skilled tracker moving through the crags.
